findings.claim: Counting logic for attractors in halves is written identically four times with only boundary parameters varying
findings.suggested_fix: Extract a helper function to count attractors in a single half, parameterized by group and boundary checks; call it four times rather than duplicating the expression.

findings.claim: Code-counting comprehension appears twice within build_mask and once in module-level code_counts, duplicating the same logic
findings.suggested_fix: Call code_counts(codes) instead of inline comprehension, or extract the logic once at module level and reuse throughout.

findings.claim: Edge detection combines three operations nested on one line—concatenate, type-cast, then diff—making intent unclear without domain knowledge
findings.suggested_fix: Split into intermediate steps or add an explanatory comment: edge detection is identifying transitions from 0-frame gaps in the core region.

findings.claim: Computing peak-to-peak range on two separate array columns and comparing both is two operations on one line
findings.suggested_fix: Use vectorised approach: moves = np.any(np.ptp(points, axis=0) > 0) to make intent clearer (attractor has movement in any axis).
